detail.requirements:
• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in gaming, entertainment, or IT/tech companies.
• Language: Fluent in Korean, and business-level Chinese or English are required to liaise with regional and headquarter stakeholders based in Mandarin-speaking regions.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills in an international, diverse environment.
detail.main_tasks:
• You will be responsible for Go to Market (GTM) work on TikTok LIVE for LIVE related features for Korean creators and viewers.
• Analyze functional usage data and formulate GTM strategy
• Create and disseminate functional utilization materials for users
• Manage KPIs through data analysis and drive cross-functional collaboration with Agency and Product teams
detail.intro: TikTok LIVE-Regional Operations-Korea aims to empower a safe, authentic, and inclusive LIVE environment and provide the best real-time experience that cultivates a sense of belonging, enhances real-life experience, enables diverse businesses and provides economic opportunities for people to interact in real-time. Members with high motivation to grow gather, and there is a culture of open discussion from a qualitative and quantitative point of view.
detail.preferred_points:
• Experience in the live-streaming industry
• GTM or event operation experience with digital products.
• Basic understanding of digital product development flow and PRD

job.position: Go To Market (GTM) Operations Manager - TikTok LIVE
